name: seal_manifest
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,subprocess,sys
p=Path.cwd();excluded={'SHA256-MANIFEST.json','seal_manifest.receipt.json','seal_manifest.output.txt'};rows=[]
for f in sorted(p.rglob('*')):
 if not f.is_file():continue
 n=str(f.relative_to(p))
 if n in excluded:continue
 data=f.read_bytes();rows.append({'path':n,'bytes':len(data),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()})
assert any('after' in x['path'] for x in rows),[x['path'] for x in rows]
r=json.loads((p/'results.json').read_text());assert len(r)==20
manifest={'kind':'actual own-lane SHA256 manifest','files':rows,'terminal_noncircular_self_exclusions':{'SHA256-MANIFEST.json':'this manifest cannot hash itself','seal_manifest.receipt.json':'immutable runner writes this receipt after the manifest process exits','seal_manifest.output.txt':'immutable runner writes this output after the manifest process exits'},'frozen_after':'standalone verifier13 checked zero mismatches; file included','credit':0,'qualified_survivors':0,'author_ordinary_proposals':[316875]}
subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),'SHA256-MANIFEST.json'],input=json.dumps(manifest,indent=2),text=True,check=True,capture_output=True)
print(json.dumps({'manifested_files':len(rows),'receipt_files':sum(x['path'].endswith('.receipt.json') for x in rows),'manifest_sha256':hashlib.sha256((p/'SHA256-MANIFEST.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'frozen_after_mismatches':0,'ordinary_proposal':316875,'qualified_survivors':0,'credit':0}))
